texts: Cold-threshold nights come in stretches of several nights.
Mild periods separate the cold stretches.
The Keepers forecast cold-threshold stretches by watching the spire weathercocks and the hearth smoke.

fields.sentence: Cold-threshold nights come in stretches of several nights.

q1_issues.issue: The bare-plural subject of a characteristic present-tense claim is minted as a specific group witness, where the instruction set routes a genuinely generic clause to a distributing Implication rule over (Member $x cold_threshold_night).

The 'several' count belongs to the nights inside one stretch, not to the subject set, so CardinalityPhrase is attached to the wrong group — and those nights' stated kind is 'night', while the group is typed cold_threshold_night.

The entire PP 'in stretches' is dropped — no stretch entity and no (In …) oblique on the come event — so a stated restriction silently disappears and the parse claims only that a group of nights came.
The come event is asserted as flat atoms at (STV 0.9 0.9), putting generic strength on an existential assertion about one specific group rather than on a rule.

q2_gaps: measure / container of-phrase ('stretches of several nights'; the instruction set's own example 'a cup of water') — it is explicitly excluded from the genitive of-phrase mapping and from the partitive rules, but given no positive encoding anywhere
a generic clause whose predicate says the kind's instances occur in multi-member runs ('X come in stretches of N') — no guidance on relating the per-instance rule to the group the PP describes
review.notes: The compound genus (Inheritance cold_threshold_night night) is the one clearly correct part; the rest conflates the subject NP with the PP's object NP into a single group.

issues.reason: "A bare plural in an episodic clause is a specific set" is restricted to a specific occurrence (past, dated, one-off); a habitual-present characteristic claim is the generic case, so minting sk_group_1 asserts that one particular set of cold-threshold nights came — an existential the generic sentence does not make.
"Several" counts the nights inside one stretch, so (CardinalityPhrase sk_group_1 "several") predicates a count of the subject set that the sentence never states — a plain falsehood in the KB.

The PP that carries the sentence's whole content is dropped with no residue, though the preposition-named oblique plus an existential group witness for the bare-plural object ("(In <event> <stretch-group>) (GroupOf <stretch-group> stretch)") is licensed and would have carried part of it; Core patterns bars silently dropping a stated qualifier, and what is left claims only that a group of nights came.

The TV dial is explicit that "individual facts keep 0.99 — the dial is only for generalizations", so 0.9/0.9 on flat atoms about a minted specific group applies generic strength to a non-generic carrier.

gaps_confirmed: measure / container of-phrase ("stretches of several nights", the prompt's own "a cup of water") — explicitly excluded from the genitive of-phrase mapping and from the partitive rules, yet given no positive encoding anywhere
a generic clause whose predicate says the kind's instances occur in multi-member runs ("X come in stretches of N") — no guidance on relating the per-instance rule to the group the PP describes
new_gaps: "come / arrive / fall in <plural container>" as a DISTRIBUTIONAL predicate: the licensed preposition-named oblique (In <event> <group>) says only that one coming happened inside a stretch, and nothing licenses the PartOf tie between the subject instance and its container group, so no head carries the claim that the kind's occurrences are grouped into runs of a stated size
adjudication.defect_summary: The subject must route through the distributing rule over (Member $x cold_threshold_night) rather than a minted group witness, with the generic 0.9/0.9 carried by that rule and the flat atoms gone; the "several" count must attach to the stretch's own group, not the subject set; the "in stretches" PP must at minimum surface as the preposition-named oblique on the come event with its own stretch group witness — but NO fully compliant form is licensed, since the container of-phrase ("stretches of several nights") has no encoding and nothing licenses tying each night to its stretch, which is the gap this sentence reports.
adjudication.notes: (Inheritance cold_threshold_night night) is the one clean atom. Three of the four confirmed issues are downstream of the same mistake — conflating the subject NP with the PP's object NP into a single group.

fields.sentence: Mild periods separate the cold stretches.

review.notes: The adjectivally-restricted bare-plural subject correctly forces the distributing-rule route with "mild" as a premise conjunct rather than a fused compound or a kind relation (the definite object also bars the kind-relation reading). Agent for the inanimate stative transitive subject and Theme for the unchanged object both follow the stated tests, and "the cold stretches" takes the group witness plus per-member distribution of the descriptive modifier.

fields.sentence: The Keepers forecast cold-threshold stretches by watching the spire weathercocks and the hearth smoke.

q1_issues.issue: Stimulus is used for an ENTITY object of 'watch', but the role list puts watch in Theme's own verb list and reserves Stimulus for a perception verb's eventive complement ('Entity objects only'), so the weathercock group should be Theme.
Same mis-slotting for the second entity object: (Stimulus sk_watch_1 sk_smoke_1) should be Theme, since the hearth smoke is an entity, not a perceived event.

The coordinated objects 'the spire weathercocks and the hearth smoke' are packed onto ONE watch event as two same-role atoms, whereas coordinated NPs are distributive by default (one event per conjunct); the collective one-event form is licensed only for reciprocal/aggregate predicates or an explicit 'together / jointly'.

(Inheritance cold_threshold threshold) is a second round of decomposition on a modifier the compound rule never exposes (a noun modifier) and leaves cold_threshold as an orphan symbol appearing in no other atom, against 'decompose once, to single-word lemmas, then stop'.

q2_gaps: a MEANS adjunct of the form 'by V-ing' (a gerund clause naming how the matrix event is carried out): Instrument is restricted to a tool, substance or conduit, and the preposition-named oblique is defined with an NP object, so a reified clausal means has no stated carrier
review.notes: 'The Keepers' is handled correctly as a Name-only individual with no GroupOf and no per-member kind, per the capitalized-plural-label rule, and the definite plural 'the spire weathercocks' correctly takes a group witness with the fused classifier in its kind slot. Note the instruction set is in tension on watch's object role — the assignment paragraph says 'psych/perception object -> Stimulus' while the Theme entry names watch outright and carves Stimulus down to eventive complements.

issues.reason: The Theme entry names 'watch' outright and restricts Stimulus to a perception verb's eventive complement ('Entity objects only'), and the parse's own Agent subject marks watch as an activity rather than the stative psych state whose object Stimulus takes.
Same rule and same mis-slot: the hearth smoke is an entity object of watch, so it takes Theme, not Stimulus.

Coordination & plurals makes coordinated NPs distributive by default ('replicate the whole predication once per conjunct'); one event carrying two same-role atoms is the collective form, licensed only for a reciprocal/aggregate predicate or an explicit 'together / jointly'.

Compound concepts decomposes 'once, to single-word lemmas, then stop' and never exposes a noun modifier, so cold_threshold gets no genus of its own — the atom is a second decomposition round and strands a symbol no other atom uses.

gaps_confirmed: a MEANS adjunct of the form 'by V-ing' (a gerund clause naming how the matrix event is carried out): Instrument is restricted to a tool, substance or conduit, and the preposition-named oblique is specified with an NP object, so a reified clausal means has no stated carrier
adjudication.defect_summary: Both watch objects take Theme rather than Stimulus; the coordinated objects distribute into two watch events, one per conjunct, each tied to the forecast by its own means atom; and (Inheritance cold_threshold threshold) is simply dropped, the compound's only licensed decomposition being the head genus (Inheritance cold_threshold_stretch stretch).
adjudication.notes: The improvised (By sk_forecast_1 sk_watch_1) means link is acceptable gap-territory improvisation — the surface preposition actually used, true of the text — and 'the Keepers' is correctly a Name-only individual with no GroupOf and no per-member kind.
